preview_outputs.reason: Generated PNG previews are useful for local review but are not required for the reproducible numeric audit.

metrics.professional_preview_score: Weighted proxy from coverage/precision, stitch density, stitch-length rhythm, directional structure, generator texture family score, and command safety.
metrics.angle_entropy: Normalized entropy of stitch orientations modulo 180 degrees.
metrics.dominant_angle_mass: Share of stitches in the dominant orientation bin.
metrics.stitch_density_per_100mm2: DST stitch segment density normalized by pattern bounding-box area.
metrics.rhythm_score: Penalty-based score for irregular stitch length distribution.
metrics.generator_texture_score: Existing texture-family proxy from fill rows, outline points, satin columns, satin rail, DT satin, and style running points.

interpretation: M2.83 shows that M2.82's command-safe multi-family substitutions do not improve the DST-derived preview texture proxy. This supports adding preview-texture gating before promoting future multi-family outputs.
